handoffs.message: Boundary audit ready for review. Added W&B to research/gateway production-deny vocabulary, made gateway TRL/RL/W&B return production_adapter_disabled before unknown_worker, expanded rejection tests for Qlib/TRL/RL/W&B and paper/canary/live modes, and documented that research-orchestrator/policy-learning/research-worker-gateway are safe service boundaries only. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/research/tests services/policy-learning/tests services/research-worker-gateway/tests -q (13 passed).

Boundary audit approved. All 5 acceptance criteria verified: (1) No EP5/Qlib/TRL/RL/W&B production activation implemented across any of the three services. (2) All services default ENABLE_PRODUCTION_ADAPTERS=false; compose-activation tests assert these env vars. (3) gap-inventory.md lines 311-323 clearly document service boundaries and explicitly prohibit citing them as production activation evidence. (4) Compose env vars confirmed false for all three services. (5) Rejection coverage complete for qlib/trl/rl/wandb + paper/canary/live modes; stub/handoff/manual lifecycle paths unaffected. Gateway correctly returns production_adapter_disabled before unknown_worker for TRL/RL/W&B. Policy-learning has hardcoded block independent of env var. 13/13 tests pass.
